ABS taxable income is the balance after eligible deductions; GIBS is not authority to transfer ABS allowances into a gross-income calculation. The following core amounts are supplemented by the ordinary claim methods below. The separate property and energy deduction conditions are recorded below. The legal basis of the webpage’s social-insurance deduction entries, the remaining cross-scheme/claim interactions and the stated drafting questions still prevent a claim to a complete relief schedule:

protected_metadata.old: Prepare an ordinary individual income-tax comparison for the year 1 July 2026 to 30 June 2027. Includes pre-death income obligations and specified allowance reductions under section 47. Includes specified approved/imported pension rules; Category 2, HEPSS, other pension cases, frontier-worker treaty residence and special deductions require separate review. This source-cited draft supports preparation of reviewable working papers using the stated periods, evidence requirements and computation examples. Retain source evidence and effective dates; unresolved points and professional review remain explicit. Use the linked official materials when checking a case, and obtain a qualified local review before filing or making a payment. Read the explicit exclusions before applying its calculations to different facts.
